description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink project and handles execution of test cases through AJAX calls, interacting with XML-RPC servers to execute test cases remotely and returning results in HTML table format.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for custom fields, handling custom field operations within TestLink.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class managing test project structure, hierarchical nodes, and subtrees in TestLink.

methods.name: remote_exec_testcase
methods.description: Handles execution of a single test case remotely and constructs the XML response with results.

methods.name: remote_exec_testcase_set
methods.description: Executes a set of test cases within a subtree and returns their results in XML format.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves input arguments for the script, such as test case ID and execution level.
